about: The counts the thesis's LuaLaTeX counter (wordcount.lua, now in archived/lua-wordcount/) gave for these documents, compiled 2026-10-25 with the thesis's preamble (MiKTeX, latexmk -lualatex): the \wc@set lines of main.aux. 3-fixture.tex is the converter's output for 3-fixture.md (with glossary.md and 0-preamble.md); probe.tex is raw LaTeX a note may hold, one section per construct.
